content.title: Marvel Reunion At Oscars Has Robert Downey Jr. & Chris Evans Exchanging Gifts, One Being Channing Tatum’s ‘Magic Mike’ Thong
content.text: “What did you get us for our anniversary?” Chris Evans asked Robert Downey Jr. when they took the stage at the Oscars to present the screenplay categories. “Hold on, I’m doing a…” answered the actor who plays Iron Man and will play Dr. Doom into the upcoming Marvel Studios’ Avengers: Doomsday out on Dec. 18. As has been teased, Chris Evans’ Steve Rogers is expected to come back in the Anthony and Joe Russo directed holiday tentpole. “It’s the 14th anniversary of our first Avengers movie. I got you a signed copy of the original script, signed by the whole cast, it’s backstage.”Downey Jr. responded, “You thought this through?” Then hysterically grasping, the Iron Man thespian continued, “No, I got it.” Watch on Deadline Visit Advertiser websiteGO TO PAGE He then gave Evan his valet parking ticket. “You self, drove?” asked Evans. “I did, I’m a man of the people,” said Downey Jr. But that wasn’t the punchline of the whole set. They then presented the Oscar for Adapted Screenplay, which was won by Paul Thomas Anderson for One Battle After Another, the filmmaker’s first win out of 14 Oscar noms. After Anderson left the stage, Evans was left solo at the mic, and seemed a bit confused where Downey Jr. was. But then the prankster came back a gift for his fellow Avengers star: “I was just joshing, of course I got you something. I got you the official Channing Tatum thong from Magic Mike. It’s sequin, with a mirror ball effect.” RELATED: Conan O’Brien Teases Timothée Chalamet In First Moments Of Oscar’s Opening Monologue Evans said about the undies, “I have no words…” From the seats, Tatum, aka Gambit in the Marvel Cinematic Universe: “Hey, I’m gonna need that back though!” “For what?” blurted Downey Jr. Said Tatum subtlety, “I gotta work later, bro.” Off which Downey Jr. went into the nominees for Best Original Screenplay.
